methodology.encounters: Isolated stages 5/10/15/20. Grant exact total XP dropped by all preceding stages; select from actual random three-button upgrade and relic offers; set normal full HP at encounter entry. No injected kills or HP alterations in measured combat. These are healthy-entry conditional encounter results, not prior-stage survival claims.
methodology.encounter_movement: Simple left/right movement using the normal collision function; reverse at arena edges/obstacles, no dash. Arena RNG reset to 100000 + seed * 100 + stage immediately before encounter generation so geometry and initial enemy placements match old/new.
methodology.campaigns: Start stage 1 at ordinary 100 HP and earn every kill, XP crystal, potion, level heal, and arena-clear heal through actual game simulation. No injected kills, XP, health resets, or invulnerability. Controller kites with collision and bullet avoidance, uses ordinary emergency dash, and Comet Strider also makes offensive dashes. After all enemies and drops are cleared, center-portal travel is skipped; the ordinary portal transition and subsequent stage start execute.
methodology.choices: Greedy strongest-plausible Farshot/damage/speed/range strategy among actual offered choices; skips fully ineffective upgrades when another useful offer exists. Real two-stat relics selected from three actual offers. Mage/dash use suitable ability-focused priorities. This is a feasible policy, not an exhaustive optimum over every future random offer.
limitations: Five seeds per main strategy, one per additional path; controller results are not human playtesting.
Old and new eligible-offer pools/RNG algorithms differ. Arena geometry is paired for isolated encounters, but rewards and natural campaigns are not identically paired.
Time limit is a test budget. A live timeout is distinct from death and can be caused by controller/pathing stalls. Medians exclude failed clears, and counts are supplied to avoid hiding censoring.
Minimum HP is the lowest absolute HP divided by entry HP. Normal level-ups can increase maximum HP during an arena, so 100% does not prove that no damage was received.
